fixes.imslpPage: Trio for Clarinet, Horn and Piano, Op.8 (Tovey, Donald Francis)
fixes.notes: Tovey's own violin, cello and piano version of his Trio for clarinet, horn and piano; three movements

results.note: Op. 8 is the same work as IMSLP's 'Trio for Clarinet, Horn and Piano, Op.8' (Style tragique), composed 1895; the violin-cello-piano version is Tovey's own, published with it by Schott in 1912. It is on IMSLP (arrangement section), so 'not on IMSLP' is wrong. The clarinet-horn original has no string part (out of scope). Toccata TOCC0068 recording 27:24
